newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel hits fresh year high.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel hits fresh year high.

text.p: Shares in Alcatel Alsthom gained 2.21 percent and set a fresh year high with analysts saying the share still has a lot of potential due to the company's restructuring.
At 1451 GMT it was up 2.21 percent at 600 francs, having reached a high of 608 francs.
Some analysts said the share could rise to 700 francs in the next few weeks but they added it was unlikely it would return to its 1994 high of 800 francs.
"The profitability goals set out by (chairman) Serge Tchuruk seem to be within reach," a dealer said.
Another analyst said that this weekend's world telecommunications pact would be good for telecoms equipment makers such as Alcatel or Siemens.
Some dealers said the possibility of Alcatel acquiring a stake in Thomson-CSF was capping the share's potential rise. But others said this was of diminishing importance.
"The market is ready to trust Tchuruk blindly when he says that (Thomson-CSF) will not hurt the results," a dealer said.
